content:
Priya Nair: Postmortem action tracker for the regional failover postmortem. Goal: close gaps (runbooks, backups, routing), assign owners, and set a game-day to validate fixes. I'll list proposed owners below; please ack or propose alternate owners.

Alex Chen: Thanks Priya. Quick ask: keep this thread as the canonical tracker and add links to Jira/PRs. I can help escalate if owners miss ETA.

Mateo Ruiz: I'll own automated routing test harness + failback tests (latency-aware and capacity-aware flows). Deliverables: test scripts, CI job, and a perf baseline report. ETA: 10 business days. Need a sandbox cluster: infra-test-4.

Kira Owens: Taking the restore & snapshot runbook updates. Will add explicit steps for point-in-time recovery, replica promotion, and post-restore data validation. Draft path: `docs/runbooks/dr_restore.md`. ETA: 5 business days.

Daniel Ho: Observed pattern across 4+ incidents: cache inconsistency after region flip -> client errors. Plan: implement a pre-failover KV sync/drain and connection handoff. I'll prototype a hook that runs `redis-sync --wait` + healthcheck. ETA: 4 days.

Samir Patel: Router policy work: adding `rollout-safe-failover-v2` with circuit-breaker and telemetry for rollback windows. PR: https://gitlab.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1301. Aim for review in 48 hours. Will also add feature flag toggles.

Lina Park: I can coordinate the game day. Proposing Thu 2026-04-14 08:00 PT, 3-hour window. Agenda: 1) runbook restore dry-run, 2) routing failover + cache-drain validation, 3) rollback and postmortem check. Is that date OK for oncall team?

oncall-bot: Oncall rota check: primary available for 2026-04-14. Reserving #war-room-drill.

ops-bot: Jira epic created: INFRA-8022 (regional failover remediation & validation). Link: https://jira.redwood/browse/INFRA-8022. Tag all PRs/docs with INFRA-8022.

Priya Nair: I'll prepare customer comm templates and an internal incident summary for CSMs. ETA: 3 business days. Need legal quick review on FAQ language. @Alex Chen can you route the legal ping?

Alex Chen: Will ping legal and policy. Also setting up a 30-min weekly sync (Wednesdays) for progress until the epic is closed. First sync: Wed 2026-03-31 09:30 PT.

Mateo Ruiz: Note on tests: prefer a controlled failover vs. chaos injection. We'll use traffic-shadowing and synthetic traffic to validate. @Samir Patel please create access to infra-test-4 and open an IAM ticket.

Samir Patel: Done — granting access. Example commands for provisioning the test stack:
```
# provision infra-test-4
aws-vault exec infra-admin -- terraform apply -var='env=infra-test-4' -auto-approve
kubectl --context infra-test-4 create namespace dr-sim
```

Daniel Ho: For the KV drain hook I'll add to the routing orchestration playbook: 1) run kv-sync, 2) verify commit index, 3) wait 45s (tunable), 4) flip traffic. Defaults: wait 45s. Tests will measure client error rate.

Kira Owens: Adding replication lag capture and alert thresholds to the runbook. During the incident we saw replica lag spikes ~8s. Will add acceptance criteria for failover: lag < 2s for 2 consecutive samples, else abort.

Priya Nair: Drafted customer FAQ in the shared sheet (link on the epic). Will workshop with CSMs once legal gives the OK.

Alex Chen: Consolidated action items here:
- Mateo: routing test harness + automation (10 business days)
- Kira: restore & snapshot runbook updates + validation (5 business days)
- Daniel: KV pre-failover drain hook + tests (4 days)
- Samir: router policy PR + test env access (PR open; access granted)
- Priya: comms & FAQ draft (3 business days)
- Lina / ops-bot: game day logistics (proposed 2026-04-14)

ops-bot: Reminder: please prefix PR titles with "INFRA-8022:" for auto-linking.

Mateo Ruiz: :white_check_mark: on owner. Will update the epic with subtasks.
Kira Owens: :white_check_mark:
Daniel Ho: :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: :white_check_mark:
Priya Nair: :white_check_mark: pending legal
Lina Park: Confirming game day with calendar — tentative OK.

Alex Chen: Also flagging recurring detection: multi-region routing misconfig + delayed cache drains. We'll add a regression test to the CI so similar changes fail the gating checks. Owner: Mateo + Daniel to propose test cases.

Priya Nair: If anyone needs to reassign, reply here. I'll update the spreadsheet and the epic.

Alex Chen: Closing initial triage. Please update the Jira cards as tasks progress. I'll follow up in the weekly sync. Thanks all. :tada:
